content: For patients diagnosed with type 2 diabetes who are at an elevated risk of cardiovascular or kidney disease, the use of SGLT2 inhibitors and GLP-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) is strongly recommended. These medications are preferred due to their ability to reduce the risk of hypoglycemia while also providing significant cardiovascular and renal protective benefits. This recommendation is particularly emphasized for individuals who are at risk of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD), heart failure (HF), or chronic kidney disease (CKD).
